summary: GitHub App transition PAT fallback warnings are limited to once per owner, app and reason per hour in each daemon process, with suppressed_count on the next warning.

rules.detail: Fallback selection and telemetry still count every selection; only warning emission is limited.

compatibility.detail: Warnings retain their existing fields and add suppressed_count, initially zero. The limiter retains at most 1024 keys; new keys prune expired windows and their pending counts. When full, untracked keys log without suppression. All windows reset on restart.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores a warning for every fallback selection.
